class.name: CgameAssetConflicts
class.brief_description: Asset scans, three-way scene merge, exclusive locks and override conflicts.
class.description: [CgameAssetConflicts] collects the tooling needed to detect and resolve concurrent changes to project assets. [b]Scanning.[/b] [method scan] hashes every file of a directory with SHA-256 and [method changed_paths] and [method three_way_binary] compare scans. [b]Three-way merge.[/b] [method merge_scene] and [method three_way] compare node properties of a base, a local and a remote scene (node path -> property -> value, the reserved property [code]"_type"[/code] holds the node type). A value changed on one side only is taken, a value changed on both sides to different values is a conflict and the local value is kept. [b]Locks.[/b] Instances of this class keep Perforce-style exclusive checkout locks with an expiry time. [b]Overrides.[/b] [method override_conflicts] reports instance overrides that clash with changes of the inherited scene. Conflict dictionaries have a [code]kind[/code] of [code]"property"[/code], [code]"add_add"[/code], [code]"delete_edit"[/code], [code]"binary"[/code], [code]"orphaned_override"[/code] or [code]"override_vs_base"[/code].

method.name: active_locks
method.description: Returns [code]path -> owner[/code] for all unexpired locks. A negative [param now] uses the system clock.

method.name: can_edit
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param path] is free or locked by [param user].

method.name: changed_paths
method.description: Returns the sorted paths whose hash differs between the scans [param a] and [param b]: added, removed or modified files.

method.name: flatten_scene_dict
method.description: Flattens a nested scene dictionary [code]{name, type, props, children}[/code] into [code]node path -> properties[/code].

method.name: hash_file
method.description: Returns [code]{"sha256": String, "size": int}[/code] of a file. The hash is empty if the file cannot be read.

method.name: lock
method.description: Takes or refreshes an exclusive lock on [param path] for [param ttl_sec] seconds. Returns [code]false[/code] if another user holds an unexpired lock. A negative [param now] uses the system clock; pass a fixed value in tests.

method.name: merge_scene
method.description: Merges two scenes against their common ancestor. Returns [code]{"merged": Dictionary, "conflicts": Array}[/code]. Added nodes of both sides are kept, a node deleted on one side and unchanged on the other is removed, and in conflicts the merged result keeps the value of [param mine].

method.name: override_conflicts
method.description: Reports conflicts between instance overrides ([code]node path -> {property: value}[/code]) and changes of the inherited scene ([code]node path -> {"removed": bool, "props": {property: new value}}[/code]). Results are [code]"orphaned_override"[/code] for nodes removed upstream and [code]"override_vs_base"[/code] for properties changed upstream that the instance overrides differently.

method.name: owner
method.description: Returns the user holding the lock on [param path], or an empty string if it is free or the lock expired.

method.name: parse_tscn
method.description: Parses the node headers and [code]key = value[/code] lines of a text scene into [code]node path -> properties[/code]. Values are kept as raw strings.

method.name: scan
method.description: Recursively hashes every file below [param dir]. Hidden entries are skipped. Returns [code]path -> {"sha256", "size"}[/code].

method.name: three_way
method.description: Returns only the conflicts of [method merge_scene].

method.name: three_way_binary
method.description: Returns the files that changed differently on both sides, from three scans, as [code]{kind: "binary", path, base, mine, theirs}[/code].

method.name: unlock
method.description: Releases the lock on [param path] if [param user] holds it, or regardless of the owner if [param force] is [code]true[/code]. Returns whether a lock was released.

constants.constant: Number of bytes read per step when hashing a file.
